companyDescription: Direct-to-smartphone satellite broadband · BlueBird constellation now 13 birds up, production through satellite 42 — building a space-based cellular network standard phones can already use
priceNote: Live $33.69 on Nov 11, 2026. The prior report (Aug 13) used $74.31, a -54.7% drift over 90 days. The J-LEO (Sep 15) catalyst date has passed.
summary: ⚠️ THESIS BROKEN — the Aug 13 report assumed a ~Sep 15 Japan J-LEO award and a smooth constellation scale-up at $74. The stock is now $33.69 (-55%). The J-LEO outcome was not verified in this refresh, and the old framing is void. Q3 2026 revenue was $42.3M (+187% y/y) but missed ~$46M consensus, the GAAP net loss widened to $132.4M, and net long-term debt nearly doubled to $4.1B (from $2.2B at YE25). New commitments include ~$900M for the Firefly Blacklift rocket program and Rakuten JV funding; cash is $3.2B. The FY26 revenue guide of $150–200M was kept. Sizing is cut 3% → 1%, and the report goes post-stage. Core Base bias +23.7pp vs realized 14d P75 +6.6%, so Base is a multi-week horizon, not a 14-day call.

macroRisk.rateOutlook: The Fed held at 3.75–4.00% on Oct 28. After the hot Oct CPI on Nov 10, CME FedWatch prices a +25bp hike at the Dec 9 FOMC at ~89–100%, with ~10% odds of 50bp. The 10-year is ~4.98%.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Oct CPI: headline +0.4% m/m, core +0.3% m/m vs 0.2% expected. Sep core PCE 3.1% y/y. Oct PCE (Nov 25) and Nov CPI (Dec 10) are next.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: ASTS is the definition of a long-duration asset: no meaningful current cash flow, a constellation funded by convertible debt, and terminal value doing all the work. Rate moves hit this harder than almost anything else on the board, and the Jul 2026 convert raise makes financing conditions a live variable rather than a background one.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — a 25bp December hike is priced after the hot CPI. The tails are a 50bp move or a hot Nov 25 PCE, both of which hit small caps first, so the dip entry is preferred.

catalystSpot.preRunup: The run already happened: +17.0% in the nine days spanning the Aug 5 launch and the Q2 print. Feedback prior note — satellite_launch is the current tier-2 LEADER (medianExcessVsBenchPct +7.4pp vs +1.4 overall, softHitRate 50%, n=8). Per the guardrail that is a mild tailwind for a pick that already stands on its own, NOT a reason to size up, and n=8 is a small sample.
catalystSpot.preRunupTiming: 1-2 สัปดาห์ก่อน launch

postWin.note: Range is genuinely wide because launch significance varies enormously. ASTS's own BlueBird 1 launch (Apr 2024) produced +100% because it proved the concept; incremental launches into an existing constellation are worth far less, which is why the Aug 5 launch moved the stock ~17% rather than double.

postLose.note: For ASTS the realistic downside catalyst is financing, not launch failure: the Jul 2026 $1.15B convertible offering took the stock down 13% after hours. A launch anomaly would be worse.
